description: A simple 5-hole pendant-style ocarina, fingered by opening holes sequentially starting from the one nearest the mouthpiece end - the common convention for cheap mass-produced 5-hole ocarinas, even though ocarinas are closed-vessel (Helmholtz) resonators rather than open tubes like the whistle, so this sequential model is a convention rather than strict acoustics. Only the major-pentatonic scale degrees (root, 2, 3, 5, 6) have a settled standard fingering; other steps are left undefined rather than guessing at a cross-fingering, since ocarina designs and hole placement vary too much to have one settled answer. Ocarinas also don't overblow cleanly to a second register the way whistles do, so range is capped at these six notes.
